title: cotula pygmaea
intro: Cotula pygmaea, commonly known as dwarf cotula or pygmy cotula, is a small, delicate perennial plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Cotula pygmaea include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
